concerns.text: SC-003 requires the family-wise error rate to be 'measured against the nominal alpha level (0.05)'. T007r only produces corrected p-values (`corrected_pvalues`, `methodology.controlled_alpha`); no task measures or reports an FWER quantity, so SC-003 has no evidence-producing task. Either add a reporting step (e.g., report the number of rejections at alpha=0.05 and the controlled alpha as the FWER bound) or record a documented deviation.

concerns.text: No task creates or pins `code/requirements.txt`. The constitution requires a pinned requirements file and the plan lists it under `code/`, yet every task assumes dependencies exist. Add a setup task (or fold into T001) that writes `code/requirements.txt` with pinned versions, including resolving the plan's unresolved `gudhi (or dionysus2)` library choice — no task selects the PH library, so the pin cannot be written deterministically.

Plan element `00_checksum_verify.py` (and state-file hash recording) has no task; checksums are folded into T001 step 3 writing only `data/checksums.txt`. The tasks.md revision note explains the `state/` exclusion, but the plan's Constitution III row still describes the dropped script — add a one-line note in the coverage map or accept the documented deviation so the plan element is not silently uncovered.
